definitions.explanation: To go beyond a limit or amount.

examples.japanese: ⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{超|こ}す。
⟦{気温|きおん}→気温：00235_kion⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{四十度|よんじゅうど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{超|こ}した。
⟦{参加者|さんかしゃ}→参加者：03059_sankasha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{百人|ひゃくにん}→百人：10985_hyakunin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{超|こ}して、⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}りきれなかった→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: The number of participants exceeded a hundred, and they couldn't all fit in the venue.

examples.japanese: ⟦{予想|よそう}→予想：03664_yosou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{超|こ}す⟦{数|かず}→数：00204_kazu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
examples.english: More people gathered than anyone had expected.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{三十五度|さんじゅうごど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{超|こ}す⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いた→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: This summer there was a long run of days over 35 degrees.

examples.japanese: {売|う}り{上|あ}げ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{一億円|いちおくえん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{超|こ}した。

notes:
{超|こ}す is a godan verb meaning to exceed or surpass a limit.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- Takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ particle: 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{超|こ}す

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{超|こ}す: to exceed the budget
- ⟦{限度|げんど}→限度：00063_gendo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{超|こ}す: to exceed the limit
- ⟦{予想|よそう}→予想：03664_yosou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{超|こ}す: to exceed expectations
- ⟦{百万|ひゃくまん}→百万：08109_hyakuman⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{超|こ}す: to exceed one million

WRITING (same reading):
- {超|こ}す: to exceed, surpass (abstract limits)
- ⟦{越|こ}す→越す：02282_kosu⟧: to cross over, pass through (physical movement); getting through a period or hardship is also 越す: ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{越|こ}す→越す：02282_kosu⟧ (to get through the winter), not {超|こ}す

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{超|こ}える→超える：01942_koeru⟧: same meaning (ichidan verb variant)
- ⟦{上回|うわまわ}る→上回る：07648_uwamawaru⟧: to surpass, exceed
